body.x: Timbuk2, (www.timbuk2.com) the San Francisco-based retailer and pioneer of the laptop bag, launches their “Break up with your Bag” Program at CES 2012. On Jan. 10-13, 2012, all show attendees will have the opportunity to stop by the Timbuk2 booth, located at booth# 11 in the Central Plaza near registration, to ditch their old bag for a new Timbuk2 laptop bag at a discounted price of $40, more than 50 percent off of MSRP. All bags and proceeds will be donated to non-profit organization and longstanding Timbuk2 partner, At The Crossroads, to provide bags and services for homeless youth and young adults that are looking to rebuild their lives.

“We’re thrilled to bring our “Break up with your Bag” Program to CES in 2012,” said Mike Wallenfels, CEO at Timbuk2. “While we were born out of our bike messenger roots, we’ve been creating technology portage solutions in the tech epicenter of the U.S. since the launch of the first laptop in the late 1980s and we want to offer CES attendees a chance to replace their laptop bag with the smartest solution available, while also giving back.”

Timbuk2 will have a large bin at their booth for attendees to donate their old bag. Timbuk2 bags for purchase for $40, while supplies last, include the Command Messenger, an International CES Innovations 2011 Design and Engineering Awards Honoree and TSA-compliant messenger bag originally priced at $130; D-Lux Laptop Messenger, a classic messenger with laptop protection typically priced at $120; Control Laptop Case, a TSA-compliant stylish briefcase usually priced at $89; and the Q Backpack, Timbuk2’s top-selling laptop pack with swing-around access generally priced at $99.

At The Crossroads reaches out to San Francisco’s homeless youth and young adults to help them build healthy, fulfilling lives. Through nighttime street outreach, one-on-one counseling, and partnership collaboration, At The Crossroads accesses young people typically overlooked by more traditional services. At The Crossroads distributes Timbuk2 bags to their clients to provide a small but much needed boost in spirit.

To participate in the “Break up with your Bag” Program or to see the full Timbuk2 bags and accessories assortment at CES 2012, visit the Timbuk2 booth at booth# 11 in the Central Plaza near registration.
